headline: Libyan Factions Ratify Turkey Maritime Boundary Agreement
summary: Libya's Benghazi-based House of Representatives ratified the maritime boundary agreement with Turkey, matching the Tripoli government's earlier approval and complicating Mediterranean offshore operations for international oil majors.
why: Libya possesses Africa's largest proven crude oil reserves; maritime demarcation disputes in the Eastern Mediterranean directly affect exploration licensing and international energy developers.

impacts.name: Energy Exploration
impacts.why: Cross-factional ratification strengthens Turkish exploration claims while heightening regulatory uncertainty for Western oil majors.
